description: Discover the best hotels in Hoi An, Vietnam. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.vendor_name: Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness
hotels.title: Hoi An All-Inclusive Beachfront Haven with Massages & Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Find refuge at Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness, resting on the shimmering sands of Binh Minh beach just south of vibrant Hoi An. This hidden gem is a wellness paradise, enveloped by lush tropical gardens and providing direct beach access. Spend moments lazing by the resplendent pool or engaging in a range of superb activities, including yoga sessions, tai chi classes and more. Enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine at Binh Minh Restaurant or head to Ngoc Linh Spa for indulgent high-quality treatments. When you're ready to explore, hop on the resort's shuttle bus for the quick trip to delightful Hoi An Ancient Town to explore its layered history and culture, strolling through old Japanese merchant buildings, Chinese temples and ancient tea houses.

hotels.vendor_name: Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness
hotels.title: Hoi An Beachfront Retreat with Lush Wellness Spa
hotels.description: Bask in the luxury of Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness, located alongside the picturesque Binh Minh beach. This hidden gem is a wellness paradise, enveloped by lush tropical gardens and direct beach access and offering high-quality spa treatments and revitalising yoga and Tai Chi classes. Savour the finest Vietnamese delicacies at the exclusive restaurant and embark on private tours to discover the hidden gems of Hoi An and its ancient surroundings.

hotels.vendor_name: Moire Hoi An, Vignette Collection (formerly Bay Resort Hoi An3)
hotels.title: Five-Star Hoi An Opulence on Hoai River with Restaurant, Bar & Pool with Ancient Town Views
hotels.description: Retreat to the banks of the Hoai River at this enchanting escape designed to embrace the very best of this vibrant Vietnamese town. With hints of local architecture intertwined with sleek modern features, this charming hotel is the perfect riverside abode, just minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hoi An Ancient Town. Savour Mediterranean flavours at the onsite restaurant, sip cocktails by the pool and take a moment of rest at Breathe Spa - here, there's no reason to rush.

hotels.vendor_name: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa
hotels.title: Hoi An Oceanfront Serenity with Onsite Dining, Outdoor Pool & Private Beach
hotels.description: Step through traditional Vietnamese doors to discover this serene retreat where a sprawling pool flows among palm-fringed gardens, framed by a long stretch of pristine private beach. Lose track of time while gliding through the water on a kayak, escape to the ultra-tranquil Victoria Spa for a treatment or catch a film at the onsite cinema. Savour Asian and European dishes at the L’Annam Restaurant, unwind poolside with a tropical tipple from Faifo Bar or enjoy a game of billiards at Elephant Bar. When it’s time to venture into town, the quaint streets and canals of the UNESCO heritage-listed Hoi An Ancient Town are just 15-minutes away.

hotels.title: Hoi An Escape with Daily Breakfast, Three-Course Lunch or Dinner & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Modern luxury meets ancient traditions at this sophisticated, central stay just steps from the UNESCO heritage-listed Hoi An Ancient Town. With a sparkling pool at its centre, five diverse eateries, a serene day spa and sauna, a fitness centre and an exclusive cinema room, days spent in the resort are just as colourful as those exploring Hoi An. Start your day with a delicious buffet breakfast before unearthing lantern-lit alleys, humming street markets and historic buildings. You'll be spoilt for choice between lunch or dinner at Swim City's laid-back poolside setting, BANG HUU's artisanal coffee shop or XUA & NAY's relaxed urban bistro. Wafaifo Resort Hoi An’s contemporary architecture, sprinkled with traditional Vietnamese motifs, provides the ultimate oasis amid an energetic city. The serenity continues to the onsite spa, where a tension-melting massage will cap off the perfect stay.

hotels.vendor_name: Wyndham Hoi An Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas
hotels.title: Hoi An Beachfront Haven with Gourmet Dining, Rooftop Bar, Infinity Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Experience the magic of Vietnam’s ancient town with a five-star stay at Wyndham Hoi An Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas. Set on the pristine shores of the South China Sea, this luxurious resort is a tranquil oasis located on the golden sands between Da Nang and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Hoi An Old Town. Sink your toes into the soft sand of An Bang Beach, where you’ll have a front-row seat to golden sunrises, and enjoy the resort’s state-of-the-art facilities, including the tranquil Royal Retreat Spa and sprawling infinity pool. Treat your palate to authentic Vietnamese cuisine at the resort's many onsite restaurants, or venture out to explore the vibrant local food scene at Hoi An Night Market. Take a leisurely bike ride through the lush rice fields, visit the historic Japanese Covered Bridge, or explore the colourful lantern-lit streets of Hoi An’s Old Town before heading back to the resort for a nightcap at Chill Sky Bar.
